design_overview: A warm, floral-toned mobile app for customers, couriers and admins. Six connected screens cover browsing, a 3-step checkout, live tracking, account and history, and admin management, built with cards, clear hierarchy and large touch targets.

screens.name: Flower Catalog
screens.purpose: Browse, search and filter bouquets by category, price and color, then open details or add to cart.

key_components.name: Catalog Header
key_components.styling: Soft pink gradient bar with title 'Fresh Flowers', location subtitle and bell icon at right.
key_components.interaction: Bell opens the notifications list.

key_components.name: Search Input
key_components.styling: Rounded white field with shadow, placeholder 'Search roses, tulips, bouquets', search icon on left.
key_components.interaction: Typing lists matching in-stock items within 2 seconds.

key_components.name: Filter Button
key_components.styling: Square 48px outlined button beside search, with a small rose dot when filters are active.
key_components.interaction: Opens the Filter bottom sheet.

key_components.name: Category Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scroll chips: 'All', 'Birthday', 'Romance', 'Wedding', 'Sympathy'. Selected chip is filled rose.
key_components.interaction: Tap filters the grid to that category.

key_components.name: Seasonal Banner
key_components.styling: Rounded photo card with dark overlay, text 'Mother's Day Bouquets' and a small 'Shop now' pill.
key_components.interaction: Opens the Mother's Day category results.

key_components.name: Bouquet Grid Card
key_components.styling: Two-column cards with rounded photo, name, color dot, bold price like '$45.00' and a round 'Add' button.
key_components.interaction: Card opens Bouquet Details; Add puts item in cart.

key_components.name: Favorite Toggle
key_components.styling: Circular white button on each card photo corner; heart fills rose when saved.
key_components.interaction: Toggles saving the bouquet to favorites.

key_components.name: Filter Bottom Sheet
key_components.styling: Rounded-top sheet with price range slider, color swatches, 'Reset' text button and rose 'Show 24 results' button.
key_components.interaction: Show results applies filters and returns to the grid.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with four tabs: Shop, Cart with count badge, Orders, Account. Active tab is rose.
key_components.interaction: Switches between main screens.

screens.user_flow: Opens after login or as guest. Leaves via Add (Cart badge, then Cart & Checkout), bottom tabs, or the bell.

screens.name: Cart and Checkout
screens.purpose: Review items, set address, delivery date and card payment, then place the order in a few steps.

key_components.name: Checkout Header
key_components.styling: White bar with back arrow, title 'Your Cart' and a step label 'Step 1 of 3'.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Flower Catalog.

key_components.name: Cart Item List
key_components.styling: Row cards with thumbnail, bouquet name, price, quantity stepper and a trash icon at right.
key_components.interaction: Stepper changes quantity; trash removes the item.

key_components.name: Address Selector
key_components.styling: Rounded field showing saved address 'Home, 24 Maple St', with edit icon and 'Add new address' link.
key_components.interaction: Opens a saved-address picker sheet.

key_components.name: Delivery Date Picker
key_components.styling: Date field with placeholder 'Choose delivery date' and time-slot chips below: 'Morning', 'Afternoon', 'Evening'.
key_components.interaction: Opens a calendar; unavailable dates are greyed.

key_components.name: Card Payment Fields
key_components.styling: Secure Stripe-style group: 'Card number', 'MM/YY', 'CVC' fields with a small 'Secured by Stripe' caption.
key_components.interaction: Validates card format as the user types.

key_components.name: Order Summary
key_components.styling: Soft grey card listing 'Subtotal', 'Delivery', 'Total' with bold total in rose.
key_components.interaction: Updates live as quantities change.

key_components.name: Payment Error Banner
key_components.styling: Red-tinted banner with text 'Payment declined. No order was created. Try another card.' and dismiss action.
key_components.interaction: Appears on declined payment; dismiss keeps cart intact.

key_components.name: Place Order Button
key_components.styling: Full-width sticky rose gradient button, 56px tall, label 'Pay $98.00 and Place Order'.
key_components.interaction: Submits payment and opens the confirmation modal.

key_components.name: Order Confirmation Modal
key_components.styling: Centered white card with green check, 'Order confirmed', order number and primary 'Track Order' button.
key_components.interaction: Track Order opens Order Tracking.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Cart tab or Add action. Leaves to Order Tracking after payment, or back to the catalog.

screens.name: Order Tracking
screens.purpose: Show live order status from preparation to doorstep, with courier details and delivery confirmation.

key_components.name: Tracking Header
key_components.styling: White bar with back arrow, title 'Order #FD-1042' and a bell icon for status alerts.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Order History; bell opens notifications.

key_components.name: ETA Card
key_components.styling: Rose gradient card with large text 'Arriving today, 2:30 to 3:00 PM' and status pill 'Out for delivery'.
key_components.interaction: Static; refreshes automatically on status change.

key_components.name: Status Stepper
key_components.styling: Vertical timeline: 'Order placed', 'Preparing', 'Out for delivery', 'Delivered'. Done steps green, current step pulsing rose.
key_components.interaction: Tap a step to see its timestamp.

key_components.name: Map Preview
key_components.styling: Rounded map card with route line and courier pin, 'Open full map' pill at corner.
key_components.interaction: Opens full-screen live map.

key_components.name: Courier Card
key_components.styling: Row with round avatar, 'Daniel M.', rating, and outlined 'Call' button.
key_components.interaction: Call dials the courier.

key_components.name: Delivery Address Card
key_components.styling: Light card with address '24 Maple St', recipient note and flower thumbnails.
key_components.interaction: Tap expands order items.

key_components.name: Courier Status Button
key_components.styling: Courier-only full-width green button 'Mark as Delivered' with secondary link 'Report a problem'.
key_components.interaction: Closes order with delivery timestamp and notifies customer.

key_components.name: Share Tracking Button
key_components.styling: Outlined pill 'Share tracking link' below the address card.
key_components.interaction: Opens the system share sheet.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the confirmation modal, Order History or a push notification. Leaves via back or bottom tabs.

screens.name: Account
screens.purpose: Register or log in, and manage saved addresses and profile details for faster checkout.

key_components.name: Account Header
key_components.styling: Pink gradient header with title 'My Account' and settings icon at right.
key_components.interaction: Settings opens notification and privacy preferences.

key_components.name: Auth Segmented Control
key_components.styling: Two-segment pill toggle 'Sign In' and 'Register', selected segment filled white with shadow.
key_components.interaction: Switches between the two forms.

key_components.name: Email Input
key_components.styling: Rounded 52px field with label 'Email' and placeholder 'you@example.com'.
key_components.interaction: Validates email format on blur.

key_components.name: Password Input
key_components.styling: Rounded field with placeholder 'At least 8 characters' and show/hide text toggle.
key_components.interaction: Toggle reveals or hides the password.

key_components.name: Create Account Button
key_components.styling: Full-width rose gradient button 'Create Account'; 'Forgot password?' text link beneath.
key_components.interaction: Creates the account, logs in and opens the Shop tab.

key_components.name: Profile Summary Card
key_components.styling: Logged-in state card with round avatar, name 'Emma Clark', email and 'Edit profile' link.
key_components.interaction: Opens the profile edit form.

key_components.name: Saved Addresses List
key_components.styling: Cards labeled 'Home' and 'Office' with address text, default badge, and edit and trash icons.
key_components.interaction: Edit opens address form; trash asks to confirm delete.

key_components.name: Add Address Button
key_components.styling: Outlined rose button 'Add new address' with plus icon.
key_components.interaction: Opens the new address form sheet.

key_components.name: Log Out Button
key_components.styling: Subtle text button 'Log out' in red below a 'Delete my account' link.
key_components.interaction: Ends session and returns to Sign In.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Account tab or when checking out as a guest. Leaves to Shop after sign in, or to Order History.

screens.name: Order History
screens.purpose: List past and active orders with status and totals, and allow quick reorder of favorite bouquets.

key_components.name: History Header
key_components.styling: White bar with title 'My Orders' and a search icon at right.
key_components.interaction: Search filters orders by bouquet name or number.

key_components.name: Status Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal chips 'All', 'Active', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled'; selected chip filled rose.
key_components.interaction: Filters the order list by status.

key_components.name: Active Order Card
key_components.styling: Highlighted card with thumbnail, '#FD-1042', amber chip 'Out for delivery', total '$98.00' and chevron.
key_components.interaction: Opens Order Tracking for this order.

key_components.name: Past Order Card
key_components.styling: White card with thumbnail, order date, green chip 'Delivered', total, and item summary '2 bouquets'.
key_components.interaction: Opens order details with items and delivery timestamp.

key_components.name: Reorder Button
key_components.styling: Outlined rose pill 'Reorder' at the bottom right of each past order card.
key_components.interaction: Adds all items to cart and opens Cart and Checkout.

key_components.name: Favorite Bouquets Row
key_components.styling: Titled 'Saved favorites' horizontal row of small photo cards with heart badge.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens that bouquet in the catalog.

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Shown when filter has no orders: soft illustration, 'No orders yet' and rose button 'Browse flowers'.
key_components.interaction: Opens Flower Catalog.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: Same four-tab bar with 'Orders' active in rose.
key_components.interaction: Switches between main screens.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Orders tab or Account. Leaves to Order Tracking, Cart and Checkout via Reorder, or Flower Catalog.

screens.name: Admin Panel
screens.purpose: Let admins manage flower inventory, prices and stock, and assign paid orders to couriers.

key_components.name: Admin Header
key_components.styling: Dark plum bar with title 'Admin Console', and a bell icon with a count badge for new orders.
key_components.interaction: Bell jumps to the Orders tab.

key_components.name: Admin Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented control 'Inventory' and 'Orders' with rose underline for the active tab.
key_components.interaction: Switches between inventory and order lists.

key_components.name: Inventory Search
key_components.styling: Rounded field with placeholder 'Search flowers by name or SKU'.
key_components.interaction: Filters the inventory list as you type.

key_components.name: Inventory Item Row
key_components.styling: Rows with thumbnail, name, price '$45.00', stock chip 'Stock 12' (amber when low) and edit icon.
key_components.interaction: Edit opens the Edit Flower sheet.

key_components.name: Edit Flower Sheet
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet with inputs 'Price' and 'Stock quantity', in-stock switch and rose 'Save changes' button.
key_components.interaction: Save updates the catalog immediately and closes the sheet.

key_components.name: Add Flower Button
key_components.styling: Floating rose circular button with plus icon above the bottom bar.
key_components.interaction: Opens the new flower form with photo upload.

key_components.name: New Order Card
key_components.styling: Card with '#FD-1043', green chip 'Paid', address, delivery slot and total, plus 'Unassigned' warning label.
key_components.interaction: Tap expands order items and customer notes.

key_components.name: Courier Dropdown
key_components.styling: Select field with placeholder 'Assign courier' listing couriers with availability dots.
key_components.interaction: Choosing a courier selects them for this order.

key_components.name: Assign Button
key_components.styling: Rose filled button 'Assign Courier', disabled grey until a courier is chosen.
key_components.interaction: Sends order to courier's delivery list and notifies customer.

screens.user_flow: Admins land here after signing in with an admin role. Leaves via edit sheets, order cards, or sign out from Account.

ui_components.name: Primary Button
ui_components.styling: 56px tall, 16px radius, rose gradient, white bold label, soft shadow; pressed state darker.

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: Outlined 1.5px rose border, rose text, transparent fill, 48px tall.

ui_components.name: Text Input
ui_components.styling: 52px rounded field, light border, floating label, rose focus ring, red border on error.

ui_components.name: Product Card
ui_components.styling: 16px radius, 4:5 photo, name, price, soft shadow, round add button.

ui_components.name: Status Chip
ui_components.styling: Pill with tinted background: green delivered, amber in progress, red failed.

ui_components.name: Filter Chip
ui_components.styling: 36px pill, outlined when idle, rose filled when selected.

ui_components.name: Top App Bar
ui_components.styling: 56px bar, centered serif title, back arrow left, action icon right.
ui_components.interaction: Back navigates to the previous screen.

ui_components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
ui_components.styling: 64px white bar, top border, icon and label, rose active, count badge on Cart.

ui_components.name: Bottom Sheet
ui_components.styling: 24px top radius, drag handle, dimmed backdrop, sticky action button.
ui_components.interaction: Swipe down or tap backdrop to dismiss.

ui_components.name: Alert Banner
ui_components.styling: Rounded tinted banner with bold message and dismiss; red, green or amber by state.

responsive_design: Mobile-first 360 to 430px with 16px margins and two-column grid. Tablets use three to four columns; web uses centered 1200px layout with the tab bar becoming a top nav.
accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, 44px minimum touch targets, text labels on all icons, screen-reader labels for status and quantity, dynamic text scaling, and color never the only status indicator.
animations: Subtle 200ms transitions: slide between screens, bottom sheets rise, cart badge bounces on add, heart pops on save, status step pulses, success check draws in.
icons: Consistent outline icons from the set: home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash, share. 24px, 2px stroke, no emojis.
